key_insight: GIFT filters token-level distillation guidance using gradient geometry to reduce conflict with correctness-driven reinforcement learning.
engineering_relevance: GIFT offers a principled way to allocate teacher guidance during reasoning-model training while transitioning toward an outcome-grounded RL objective.
method: Decompose distillation gradients into components parallel and orthogonal to the RL gradient.
Rank token-level guidance by first-order conflict and novel directional value.
Progressively shrink distillation coverage, dropping conflicting guidance first while retaining selected updates at full strength.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple model scales on mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks, with relative gains up to 9.5% on difficult math tasks.
watch_item: Token-level gradient analysis may add training overhead, which the abstract does not quantify.
paper_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
